withdrawal_confirmation.value: I have read and agree with the venue's withdrawal policy on behalf of myself and my co-authors.

comment.value: During a re-analysis of our data we discovered that some of the metrics of fine-tuning runs were not recorded correctly.  As a result, some figures and tables in this draft of the paper need to be revised.  We will withdraw this version as we re-run the impacted trials, and we look forward to submitting a revised and corrected version of this paper to the next deadline.
